title: [ORIGINS] Shy
description: A durable Origin focused on managing a Resource and collecting mob heads
body:
Shy is an Origin which fits well into the hands of a peaceful player. Shy prefers to end fights quickly due to durability issues, and can afford to play risky thanks to its damage mitigation.

## The Origin

<details>
<summary>Shy</summary>

Those whose faces were torched by FlameMenders formed a secretive group. They wear the expressions made from others.
</details>

## Powers

<details>
<summary>Hidden Look</summary>
Spawn with the face of a Zombie.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Today's Expression</summary>
Conventional blades collect faces on kill.
  
> Only works against creatures who have head/skull items.     
> Conventional blades = Sword, Axe, or Shears.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Untarnished Visage</summary>
 While wearing a face, it's difficult to be injured, and minor damage is nullified.
 Your face will break after sustaining 10 hits.

> Damage greater than 2 is reduced to 2.      
> Damage below 2 is reduced to 0.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Lest the Vanity Not Match This Countenance</summary>
Armor you wear is slowly mended over time, passively
</details>


<details>
<summary>Dress to Express</summary>
Leather clothing and anything of the same level decreases Anxiety slowly, but you cannot wear other armor.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Unsociable</summary>
You wont interact with Villagers when without a face.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Anxiety</summary>
Gain Anxiety when without a face.

> The amount of Anxiety increases based on the number of nearby living creatures.     
> Players increase Anxiety more.     
> Living creatures need to have an unobstructed path of vision to increase Anxiety, but do not need to be actively looking at you.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Pleasures of the World</summary>
Lose Anxiety from: Sleeping, Eating golden foods, Being close to a flower
</details>


<details>
<summary>Misuse</summary>
At minor Anxiety, tools lose durability quicker.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Insomnia</summary>
At medium Anxiety, you can't sleep.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Trembling</summary>
At high Anxiety, you can't block with shields.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Nausea</summary>
At extreme Anxiety, you're disoriented.
</details>
